AgendaConfig.description: Which pages an agenda lists events from.

depth.description: How many levels below `from` to look; any depth when absent.

from.description: Events on pages below this path, or these paths. The pages below this one when absent.

includeUnlisted.description: Also list events on pages with `"listed": false`.

AgendaSetting.description: `true` or `false`, or which pages to list events from.

ChildOrder.description: How a page orders its children in menus and tiles: `order` (by `order`, then title), `dateDesc` (newest first) or `dateAsc` (oldest first). Undated children come last.

EventConfig.description: Makes the page an event. A detail left out is shown as "not confirmed", never guessed.

cost.description: What it costs, as the organiser states it. Leaving it out means unknown, never free.

end.description: When it ends, in the same form as `start`.

registrationUrl.description: Where to register, as an http(s) URL.

sequence.description: Raise it whenever the event changes, so calendar subscribers take the change. `vados page set-event` does so for you.

start.description: When it starts, with the UTC offset `timeZone` shows at that moment: `2026-11-05T14:00:00-05:00`.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone it happens in, such as `America/New_York`.

venue.description: Where it happens: the venue's name.

virtualUrl.description: Where to attend online, as an http(s) URL. Never taken from `registrationUrl`.

EventStatus.description: Whether the event goes ahead: `scheduled`, `cancelled`, `postponed` or `rescheduled`.

FeedConfig.description: A feed's title, size and entries.

content.description: What an entry carries; the page's full content when absent.

depth.description: How many levels below `from` to look: any depth when `from` is given, only direct children when it isn't.

from.description: Takes entries from below this path, or these paths, instead of the page's own direct children.

includeUnlisted.description: Also takes pages with `"listed": false`, which feeds otherwise leave out.

limit.description: How many entries the feed holds; 20 when absent.

title.description: The feed's title; the site title plus the page's when absent.

FeedContent.description: What a feed entry carries: `full` content, or only the `summary`.

LatestConfig.description: Which sections to take the newest dated pages from, how many, and how deep below each to look.

depth.description: How many levels below a section to look; any depth when absent.

from.description: A section's path, such as `/blog`, or a list of them.

limit.description: How many pages to show; 4 when absent.

buttonLabel.description: The register button's text; "Register" in the site's language when absent.

display.description: How the event is shown; `eventPage` when absent.

end.description: When it ends, in the same form as `start`.

eventId.description: Luma's event ID, `evt-...`, shown in the event's embed options on Luma.

start.description: When it starts, for agendas and calendars, in the same form as an event's `start`. Nothing is fetched from Luma.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone it happens in, such as `Europe/Amsterdam`.

title.description: The text of the link to the event on Luma, and the embedded event page's accessible name. Required.

LumaEventDisplay.description: How the event is shown: `eventPage` (Luma's embedded event page, with its registration), `registerButton` (a button opening Luma's registration over the page) or `both`.

Notification.description: A tile below a page's content.

color.description: The tile's Bulma colour; `Info` or `Link` when absent, depending on the tile.

content.description: The tile's text: inline HTML, or the name of a `.md` or `.html` file in the page's directory.

image.description: An image reference, such as `/team/alice`, shown in the tile.

url.description: Where the tile links to: a page's path or a full URL.

OneOrMany.description: A page's path, such as `/blog`, or a list of them.

description: One page: the `page.json` in each directory of the source tree.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, so editors can complete and check it. vados itself ignores it.

agenda.description: Lists events from elsewhere on this page, soonest first: `true` for those below it, or which pages to take them from.

childOrder.description: How this page's children are ordered in menus and tiles; `order` when absent.

content.description: The page's content: inline HTML, or the name of a `.md` or `.html` file in the page's directory.

date.description: When the page was published: `YYYY-MM-DD`, optionally with a time, such as `2026-10-22T09:30`.

feed.description: Publishes an Atom feed of the page's dated children at the page's path plus `/feed.xml`: `true`, or the feed's settings. Needs main.json's `siteUrl`.

icon.description: A Material Design Icons name, such as `home` or `rss`, shown with the page in menus.

image.description: The page's hero image, as an image reference: the image's directory in the image tree and its file name without extension, such as `/team/alice`.

latest.description: Shows the newest dated pages from elsewhere in the site as tiles.

leftNotifications.description: Tiles in the left column below the page's content.

listed.description: `false` publishes the page but keeps it out of menus, side tiles, feeds, the site search and the sitemap.

lumaEvents.description: Events hosted on Luma, shown after the page's content.

noindex.description: Keeps the page out of search results, the site search and the sitemap, while it stays listed in menus.

order.description: Where the page comes among its siblings when they are ordered by `order`: lower first, then by title.

rightNotifications.description: Tiles in the right column below the page's content.

subTitle.description: A line shown under the title.

summary.description: A short description of the page for search engines, link previews, feeds and the tiles advertising it.

title.description: The page's title: its heading, and its name in menus and tiles.

updated.description: When the page last changed meaningfully, in the same form as `date`.

title: vados page.json
